title: Read-only SQL, Runtime Registry and HardWorld boundaries
summary: NoSQLServer and Runtime Registry expose evidence-shaped, generation-pinned views. They do not own transport authority. HardWorld is downstream and mutates only through explicit promotion.
invariants: Civic SQL relations are read-only; unsupported mutation returns SQLUNSUPPORTED without fetching.
Runtime inputs expose semantic identifiers only, never deployment URL/credential/cache-root/queue selectors unless a contract explicitly requires them.
Numeric-looking source strings that must be JSON strings use Runtime Registry JsonString; this preserves type and is not numeric coercion.
HardWorld evidence/provenance may be produced without world mutation; promotion requires an explicit grant.
procedure: Freeze a relation snapshot when the contract says first-read snapshot.
Keep rich/native evidence reachable from projected rows where defined.
Pin every Runtime ability/contract/mapping generation exactly.
Do not add a source-specific HardWorld promotion shortcut when the generic evidence/promotion seam is sufficient.

provenance.claim: Read-only SQL, Runtime input pinning and explicit HardWorld promotion boundary.
v0.14 NOTAM journal SQL/Runtime surfaces remain non-JMS and non-HardWorld.
